news.title: The launcher is here
news.body: Emberfall Vale now has its own Windows launcher. It checks for new versions every time you open it, so you get new content without reinstalling. Pick windowed or fullscreen, a resolution and a graphics level in Settings.

news.title: Heroes of the Vale
news.body: Create your own hero. Choose Elf, Dwarf, Fishfolk or Undead, male or female, and your skin, hair and style. Then pick a class: the shapeshifting Druid, the Rogue, the Archer or the Warlock, each with four abilities on keys 1 to 4.

news.title: Emberfall Vale opens
news.body: Explore an open valley of meadows, forests, lakes and mountains. Help Elder Maren with four quests, level up, and face the Ember Golem in the ruins to the northeast.
